name: motion-head-turn
title: Head Turn
description: Mắt liếc trước, đầu quay theo, thân xoay sau cùng, các nhịp chồng lên nhau một chút.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Eyes shift toward the look direction 0-250 ms, head turns / moves 100-450 ms, body follows 200-600 ms, easeInOutCubic (eyes easeOutCubic in the demo); return in the same order. 100 ms offsets = overlapping action. Demo (from 0.4 s): eyes 150 ms, 14 px; head 350 ms, 12 px; body 450 ms, 6 px; return 1.5 s later. Params: eyes (0–0.25 s) · head (0.1–0.45 s) · body (0.2–0.6 s). Eyes first, then the head 0.1 s later, then the body 0.1 s after that: overlapping action; it returns in the same order.
